source: owner's K2 audit of 100 released figures (releases/2026-09-28/k2_geometry_audit.csv) plus measurements over the 1,269-figure release

taxonomy_of_the_12_thick_figures.method: source | reconstruction montage, read by eye

solid_filled_regions.what: section fill, filled handle, solid-black section hatching; skeletonized into a scribble

fine_shading_strokes.what: dense short parallel strokes shading a perspective render; vectorized as a mass

thick_outlines_proper.what: bold frame or cable; skeleton yields a thin line or a double edge -- tolerable

taxonomy_of_the_12_thick_figures.note: the two 'hatch style' audit figures are wide diagonal bands (EP3492282A1, EP2889159B1); a solid section fill is a band at 100% duty, so issues 1 and 2 are one family

corpus_sizing_proxies.method: distance transform and component shape over all 1,269 released figures; proxies, not detectors

bold_bands_ge_5.note: too loose; ordinary drawings carry a few thick short strokes

corpus_sizing_proxies.reading: each sub-defect sits at 2-4%; with overlaps that matches the audit's 12%

hatch_detector_on_the_styles.metric: HatchUNet predicted-hatch share of ink, threshold 0.7

control_ordinary_figures.note: controls carry normal thin hatching the detector correctly finds

hatch_detector_on_the_styles.reading: blind on most bold-band and shading figures (5-9% vs 28% on ordinary hatch); on the two audit figures it fired substantially yet the bands still exported as outlines

removal_side_failure.reading: detection and removal both fired; the remover is built for thin line strokes and a wide band's boundary is not one, so the band survives as an outline. There is no filled-region primitive anywhere in Stage 3 or 4 -- the only fill in the SVG writer is text.

ghost_leaders.mechanism: _trace_ocr_leaders walks the skeleton path, then stores only p1/p2; _build_removal_mask draws cv2.line(p1,p2) -- a straight chord; Stage 4 add_line(p1,p2). The curve escapes the chord mask, Stage 2 vectorizes the surviving ink, Stage 4 reinjects a straight leader beside it.

straightness_cut.effect: leaders curved beyond it are not traced at all: no ghost, but the leader ink stays as geometry and the numeral is recorded without a leader

identified_labels_without_a_leader.note: mixes numerals that genuinely have no leader with those whose leader was too curved; not separable without inspection

tooling_for_the_fix.labeller: tools/hatch_mask_label.py draws true hatch areas directly, so it captures styles the detector misses; tools/hatch_label.py only judges detector proposals and would not
tooling_for_the_fix.trainer: tools/hatch_train_cnn.py --gt <dir>; shipped model was lr 3e-4, pos_weight 3.0, test IoU 0.816 on the original styles
tooling_for_the_fix.existing_primitives: polygon exists (unfilled); DXF native hatch type exists; no fill attribute

owner_decisions_2026_09_29.filled_regions: filled polygon: SVG fill, DXF SOLID hatch
owner_decisions_2026_09_29.shading_strokes: remove like hatching; detector retrained on the style
owner_decisions_2026_09_29.curved_leaders: reinject as the traced path, a polyline
owner_decisions_2026_09_29.labelling: owner will label ~40 figures by hatch style with hatch_mask_label
